description: Treat git stage like git add and scan bash/sh/zsh -c and eval inner commands recursively in the strict commit guard, with tests and the tech-debt residual narrowed
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded, with a push after each phase. (1) Recursion is token-level with a depth cap of 4; unreadable inner text fails closed. (2) git stage is handled at the command-position detection alongside add. (3) The residual is now arbitrary wrapper scripts and shell functions only.
